output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is added to the target's balance without a check, allowing the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value, if the user is vulnerable to overflow (i.e., has a low balance and a large allowance).
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; can overflow if balanceOf[_to] is at maximum uint256, causing funds to be lost forever.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; can overflow if balanceOf[_to] is at maximum uint256, causing funds to be lost forever.

The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount variable is set to msg.value * buyRate; If buyRate is set to a very large value, a user can cause an integer overflow in the buy function, causing the buyRate to be set to a very low value, allowing attackers to steal funds.
